ontology_concepts.description: Capability to execute shell or child process commands on the host or in a sandbox
Capability to interact with external tools via Model Context Protocol servers
Capability to make outbound HTTP/TCP/UDP connections to external addresses
Capability to inspect and read files from the host or storage workspace
Capability to create, edit, or delete files on the filesystem
Capability to dynamically parse and evaluate code at runtime (e.g. eval, Function constructor)
Permission granting or requesting the ability to write or delete local files
Permission granting outbound network egress to external endpoints
Permission granting the ability to spawn sub-processes on the system
Empirical detection of dynamic decoding, string deobfuscation, or evasive execution
Empirical observed outbound transmission of sensitive memory or filesystem data
Risk arising from unverified, typosquatted, or compromised dependencies
Risk that external inputs can override system instructions and hijack execution
Fact directly verified from deterministic AST or dynamic execution trace
Assertion synthesized from evidence items through calibrated engine rules
Plausible condition with partial evidence requiring further evaluation or validation
Condition with mutually exclusive opposing evidence
Proof extracted from source spans, AST syntax, or static text matches
Proof captured from sandbox runtime events, system calls, or network packets
Proof declared in package.json, requirements.txt, Dockerfile, or MCP manifest

inferences.rationale: Inferred compound risk vector from co-occurrence of child process execution and outbound network egress capabilities.
